name: Bitdeer
description: Bitdeer began as a Bitcoin mining platform tied to Bitmain and is now a vertically integrated miner: it designs its own SEALMINER mining chips and rigs, mines Bitcoin for its own account in its datacenters (1,752 MW online) and through third-party sites, hosts other people's rigs, and sells rigs. Self-mining was 64 percent of FY2025 revenue and 74 percent of Q2 2026 revenue; rig sales were a one-off surge in 2025 ($108.3 million, nearly gone by Q2 2026 as the rigs are now kept for its own mining). It is converting some power sites to AI: a small GPU cloud ($14.0 million in Q2 2026) and a signed 16-year, $4.7 billion colocation lease for Tydal, Norway (121 IT MW, tenant a subsidiary of Volta). Gross margin is thin or negative (9.8 percent in FY2025, negative 3.7 percent in Q2 2026) and net income in FY2025 came from a $444.9 million fair-value gain on derivative liabilities, not operations.

sub.name: Crypto exchanges, miners and bitcoin holders

hq.note: 08 Kallang Avenue, Aperia Tower 1, #09-03/04 (FY2025 20-F cover); operations in the US, Norway, Bhutan, Ethiopia and Malaysia

employees.note: Full-time employees (211 at end-2023, 246 at end-2024); FY2025 20-F

businessLines.name: Self-mining (including co-mining from Q2 2026)
businessLines.how: Bitcoin block rewards received from mining pools in proportion to the hash rate contributed, recognized at the Bitcoin price when earned; electricity ($44 per MWh average in Q2 2026) and rig depreciation are the main costs.
businessLines.description: Bitcoin mined for Bitdeer's own account with its proprietary hash rate: 73.0 EH/s in own datacenters at Q2 2026, plus 15.9 EH/s co-mining in third-party datacenters.

revenue.note: FY2025 20-F Item 5 (IFRS). Latest quarter Q2 2026 (US GAAP, results release 6-K filed 2026-08-10): self-mining $168.4M plus co-mining $25.0M = $193.4M; 2,694 BTC mined.

businessLines.revenueNote: FY2025 20-F Item 5 (IFRS). Latest quarter Q2 2026 (US GAAP, results release 6-K filed 2026-08-10): self-mining $168.4M plus co-mining $25.0M = $193.4M; 2,694 BTC mined.

businessLines.name: Sale of mining rigs and accessories (SEALMINER)
businessLines.how: One-time sale of each rig at shipment; no recurring revenue, and sales depend on chip supply, manufacturing capacity and demand from other miners.
businessLines.description: Sells its own SEALMINER A2/A2 Pro rigs (and accessories) to third parties.

revenue.note: FY2025 20-F; $0.6M in FY2024. Q2 2026: $0.4M vs $69.5M in Q2 2025 (results release), because Bitdeer now deploys the rigs itself.

businessLines.revenueNote: FY2025 20-F; $0.6M in FY2024. Q2 2026: $0.4M vs $69.5M in Q2 2025 (results release), because Bitdeer now deploys the rigs itself.

businessLines.name: Hosting (General Hosting, Membership Hosting, Cloud Hosting)
businessLines.how: Monthly fee based on the customer's actual consumption of datacenter resources such as electricity (General), an upfront payment to secure capacity plus a monthly management fee (Membership), or a subscription for computing power from Bitdeer-owned rigs (Cloud Hosting); revenue shrinks when old rigs are removed after the halving.
businessLines.description: Customers' mining rigs run in Bitdeer datacenters: 8.2 EH/s hosted hash rate and 46,000 rigs at Q2 2026 (13.9 EH/s and 86,000 a year earlier).

revenue.note: General $35.0M + Membership $61.2M + Cloud Hosting $0.1M (FY2025 20-F). Q2 2026: General $2.8M + Membership $12.8M = $15.6M.

businessLines.revenueNote: General $35.0M + Membership $61.2M + Cloud Hosting $0.1M (FY2025 20-F). Q2 2026: General $2.8M + Membership $12.8M = $15.6M.

businessLines.name: AI infrastructure and AI cloud (GPU cloud and colocation)
businessLines.how: GPU cloud: customers rent access to GPU servers by usage or term without taking the hardware. Colocation (Tydal): modified-gross lease at about $202 per kW-month averaged over 16 years with 3% annual escalators, electricity passed through to the tenant, about 90% estimated NOI margin; the tenant has a no-fee termination right at 10 years.
businessLines.description: NVIDIA GPU cloud (H100, H200, B200, GB200; 2,128 GPUs deployed at 94% utilization at 2026-03-31) plus a colocation business that has not yet billed anything. Tydal, Norway campus signed to Volta in August 2026.

revenue.note: FY2025 20-F ($3.5M in FY2024). Q2 2026: $14.0M vs $1.3M (results release).

businessLines.revenueNote: FY2025 20-F ($3.5M in FY2024). Q2 2026: $14.0M vs $1.3M (results release).

businessLines.name: Cloud hash rate
businessLines.how: Fixed-price hash rate subscription (priced off Bitcoin price and network hash rate, recognized evenly over the term) plus a separate electricity fee; Bitdeer reallocates hash rate between this and self-mining depending on its view of Bitcoin.
businessLines.description: Sells slices of its proprietary hash rate on subscription.

revenue.note: Hash rate subscription $0.8M + electricity subscription $1.3M (FY2025 20-F); $67.9M in 2023 and $39.8M in 2024. Q2 2026: $3.7M (results release).

businessLines.revenueNote: Hash rate subscription $0.8M + electricity subscription $1.3M (FY2025 20-F); $67.9M in 2023 and $39.8M in 2024. Q2 2026: $3.7M (results release).

businessLines.name: Others
businessLines.how: Service fees, rents and small product sales; mixed and not a driver.
businessLines.description: Technical and human resource services, repairs of hosted rigs, lease of investment properties, sales of rig peripherals and containerized solutions.

revenue.note: FY2025 20-F. Q2 2026 residual about $1.7M (derived: $228.8M total less the seven lines shown in the release, which sum to $227.1M).

brands.name: SEALMINER (rigs) with SEAL chip series
brands.share: Rig sales 17.5% of FY2025 revenue and 0.2% of Q2 2026; the rigs also drive the self-mining hash rate (self-mining average 25.1 EH/s in FY2025; efficiency 15.8 J/TH at Q2 2026). A4 series launched April 2026 at as low as 9.45 J/TH.

brands.name: Bitdeer AI (AI cloud)
brands.share: 1.1% of FY2025 revenue; 6.1% of Q2 2026 revenue

brands.name: Datacenters (ten operating, 1,752 MW online at 2026-07-31)
brands.share: Largest sites: Rockdale TX 563 MW, Jigmeling Bhutan 500 MW, Massillon OH 174 MW, Gedu Bhutan 100 MW, Molde Norway 84 MW, Knoxville TN 86 MW (Q2 2026 release); pipeline 1,228 MW
